definitions.explanation: The sixth planet from the Sun, known for its prominent ring system. Named after the element earth (土) in the Chinese five-element system used for naming planets.

examples.japanese: {土星|どせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}→望遠鏡：05483_bouenkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{土星|どせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}した→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I observed Saturn's rings through a telescope.

examples.japanese: {土星|どせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{六番目|ろくばんめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and is made of gas.

notes:
NAMING:
Japanese planet names use the Chinese five-element system: {水|すい} (water) = Mercury, {金|きん} (metal) = Venus, {火|か} (fire) = Mars, {木|もく} (wood) = Jupiter, {土|ど} (earth) = Saturn. Saturday (⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧) is also associated with Saturn, paralleling the English naming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土星|どせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ (Saturn's rings)
- {土星|どせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (Saturn's moons)
- {土星|どせい}⟦{探査機|たんさき}→探査機：25715_tansaki⟧ (Saturn probe)
